mars.conjunction: Wanting and being wanted are one impulse in you, and you are direct about attraction in a way people find thrilling or alarming.
mars.harmonious: You pursue what you want without spoiling it, and your relationships carry warmth and appetite in roughly equal measure.
mars.square: You want and then you back off, and the habit of chasing whatever resists you and losing interest in whatever does not is yours to break.
mars.opposition: Desire and affection keep arriving in different people, and you have run at least one relationship along that split.

jupiter.conjunction: You like things generously and expensively, and your capacity for pleasure is a good deal larger than your capacity for restraint.
jupiter.harmonious: You are warm, well liked and fortunate in company, and generosity returns to you often enough that you keep offering it.
jupiter.square: You overindulge and overpromise affection, and the bill, financial or emotional, always arrives later than the pleasure did.
jupiter.opposition: Somebody else is always the extravagant one, and you have both enjoyed their appetite and paid for it.

saturn.conjunction: You take love seriously and slowly, you show it in commitments rather than words, and you assume it has to be earned.
saturn.harmonious: Your affections are durable, you are not romantic in the showy sense, and you are still there twenty years later.
saturn.square: You feel unlovable in a way that no evidence corrects, so you choose people who confirm it or keep everyone at a workable distance.
saturn.opposition: The coldness comes from the other side of the relationship, and you have waited a long time for people who were never going to arrive.

uranus.conjunction: You fall suddenly and out of nowhere, your taste is unorthodox, and conventional arrangements make you claustrophobic.
uranus.harmonious: You keep your independence inside your relationships without making a production of it, and you prefer interesting people to suitable ones.
uranus.square: You want closeness and freedom at full strength simultaneously, and you have ended things purely to feel unattached again.
uranus.opposition: The unpredictability comes from the other person, and your relationships start and finish faster than you can explain to anyone.

neptune.conjunction: You love the idea before you have met the person, and beauty affects you in a way that is close to religious.
neptune.harmonious: Your romanticism is genuine and mostly harmless, it feeds whatever you make, and you see the best in people and often draw it out.
neptune.square: You idealise, then find out, then feel betrayed by somebody who never claimed to be that; the disappointment runs to a schedule.
neptune.opposition: You have loved people who were unavailable or not quite real, and you have been the screen for someone else's fantasy too.

pluto.conjunction: Love is not a light matter for you: you attach completely, and the relationships that mattered rearranged you.
pluto.harmonious: You are capable of real intimacy rather than the sociable version, and people tell you things they have told nobody else.
pluto.square: Jealousy, control and the fear of losing somebody run underneath your affections, and one relationship taught you that the hard way.
pluto.opposition: Intensity reaches you through your partners, and you have been at both ends of a relationship that was really about power.

ascendant.conjunction: People find you pleasant to look at and easy to be around, and you have coasted on that more than you would admit.
ascendant.harmonious: Your manner is warm and unguarded, and you are given the benefit of the doubt rather more often than the average.
ascendant.square: You try to be liked and it shows, and the visible effort is what puts people off rather than anything you actually are.
ascendant.opposition: You see yourself through whoever you are with, and being on your own has always felt like being unfinished.

midheaven.conjunction: You are known for being pleasant to deal with, and your work has an element of taste, beauty or diplomacy in it.
midheaven.harmonious: Being liked helps your career and you know it, and the people you get on with are the ones who open the doors.
midheaven.square: Your relationships and your ambition compete for the same hours, and you have let one slide to keep the other going.
midheaven.opposition: Your private affections and your public standing make claims on the same evenings, and somebody is always disappointed.
